promptState.text:
Aspect ratio: 3:4
Request: a bold modern rock festival poster with a real photograph: a real fluffy white rabbit rocker wearing dark sunglasses and a black leather jacket, standing on a smoky stage with red and white stage lights, its furry white rabbit paws, not human hands, playing a plain matte black electric guitar whose neck runs out of the right edge of the poster, so no headstock is visible. The crowd in front of the stage is a dark row of black wolf silhouettes with pointed ears, some howling up at the rabbit. The title "THE RABBIT ROCKERS" is a huge spiky heavy metal band logo in white across the top, fully readable, above the rabbit's ears. A slanted red band reads "WORLD HOWL TOUR"

MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 P-H3 Image needs ComfyUI 0.44.0 or newer, the first version with these nodes. On an older ComfyUI the nodes show red: update ComfyUI first.

 Load Diffusion Model

Download minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors19.5 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/h3

Create the h3 folder if it does not exist. This is the First and Last Frame version of MiniMax H3 (fl2va): if you did Episode 41 you may already have it.

 LoRA (in LoRA Loader Pixaroma)

Download p-h3-image_lora_bf16.safetensors1.82 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/loras/h3

Create the h3 folder inside loras if it does not exist.

 Load CLIP

Download p-h3-image_text_encoder_int8_convrot.safetensors4.77 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

 Load CLIP (the prompt upsampler)

Download p-h3-image_prompt_upsampler_w4a8.safetensors6.26 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

It turns a short idea into a long prompt. Only the workflows with the upsampler need this file.

 Load VAE

Download p-h3-image_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors2.93 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

 License

P-H3 Image is built on MiniMax H3, so the MiniMax H3 Community License applies. Read it and check what it says for your country before you use the model.

READ LICENSE P-H3 Image model page 

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma: update to the latest version (these workflows need at least 1.4.250). A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

Red or missing nodes A model file is missing Buttons missing after an update

Join Discord  Pixaroma YouTube Channel  Ask for help

{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Type a short idea and the prompt upsampler writes the long prompt for you. It adds the place, the light, the camera and the small details. Use this one when you have an idea, and workflow 1 when you want to write the whole prompt yourself.

 Steps

  1. Type your idea in Prompt Pixaroma, after Request:.
  2. Pick a size on Sizes Pixaroma, and set Aspect ratio: to the same shape.
  3. Leave the seed on F to repeat a picture, or switch it to R for a new one each Run.
  4. Press Run. Read the prompt it wrote in Show Text Pixaroma.

 Writing a short idea

  • Keep both labels. The first line says the shape, the second says what you want: Aspect ratio: 3:4, then Request: a poster of ...
  • The shapes on Sizes Pixaroma are 1:1, 4:3 and 16:9. In portrait they are 3:4 and 9:16.
  • Say the look first: a photorealistic ... The upsampler keeps what you ask for and fills in the rest.
  • Words that should appear go in double quotes: the title "NEON CARROTS". It kept them exactly in our tests.
  • One line is enough to start. The demo idea is longer because it fixes things that went wrong in the first tries: the paws, the guitar and the title.

 Good to know

  • It makes things up. Give it no words and it invents a band name, a place and a date. Put the words you want in double quotes, and check Show Text Pixaroma.
  • The same idea gives the same written prompt each time. A new seed changes only the picture, and the upsampler does not run again, so that is quick.
  • An animal can get human hands. The rabbit played the guitar with hands on three of four seeds until the idea said furry white rabbit paws, not human hands.
  • Logos can sneak in. The guitars had a maker's name on them even when the idea said no logo. On the demo the neck runs off the edge of the poster, so there is no head to put a name on. Check your picture at full size.
  • Want to change one detail in the written prompt? Copy it from Show Text Pixaroma into workflow 1 and edit it there.
  • Already have a long prompt? Use workflow 1: it skips the upsampler, its download and its memory.
  • Full HD is 1920 x 1088 here: type 1080 and the model gives you 1072. HD (1280 x 720), 2K and 4K come out exact.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (MiniMax H3 fl2va) - MiniMax H3, the video model. The LoRA in the next node turns it into P-H3 Image, a picture model. If you did Episode 41 you may already have this file.
  • LoRA Loader Pixaroma (P-H3 Image) - The P-H3 Image LoRA from Pruna. Keep it on at strength 1: without it H3 is a video model and the picture falls apart.
  • Load CLIP (P-H3 Image text encoder) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something the model understands. The type must be minimax.
  • Load VAE (P-H3 Image VAE) - Turns the finished render into the picture. It is made for P-H3 Image, a different file from the H3 video VAE.
  • Load CLIP (the prompt upsampler) - The prompt upsampler: a small language model from Pruna that turns a short idea into the long prompt P-H3 Image likes. The type must be minimax.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Prompt Pixaroma (1. your short idea) - Your idea goes after Request:. Keep the two labels, and keep Aspect ratio: the same shape as the size you pick.
  • Sizes Pixaroma (2. picture size) - The picture size. Click a size; the Portrait / Landscape switch turns it on its side. From top to bottom: 1, 2, 4 and 8 megapixels, three shapes each. The labels mark 1K, HD, Full HD, 2K and 4K. Smaller is much faster.
  • Seed Pixaroma (3. fixed or random) - The seed. F (fixed) gives the same picture every Run, R (random) a new one each Run. The demo uses seed 2.

 Working in the background

Teal. They run by themselves. The line next to each one says if there is anything worth changing.

  • MiniMaxH3SigmaShift (1 / 1 for pictures) - The noise schedule. P-H3 Image needs 1 and 1. Leave it as it is.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • Generate Text (the upsampler writes the prompt) - Runs the upsampler on your idea. With sampling_mode and mtp off, the same idea gives the same written prompt every time. On auto, mtp writes a little faster, but the text can change between Runs.
  • PH3 Image Conditioning (prompt + size) - Joins the prompt and the size, and makes the empty canvas the picture is painted on.
  • Basic Guider (no CFG) - Hands the model and the prompt to the sampler. P-H3 Image needs no CFG and no negative prompt.
  • KSampler Select (sampler) - The sampler. euler is the one in Pruna's own workflow. ComfyUI's template uses er_sde: the same speed, but it broke small words on a label in our tests.
  • Manual Sigmas (the 8 steps) - The 8 steps the model was trained on. More steps do not help, so leave these numbers as they are.
  • Random Noise - The starting noise, from the seed.
  • Sampler Custom Advanced (the render) - The render itself: 8 steps. The normal KSampler cannot take this hand-made step list, so this node does the job.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (saves the picture) - Saves each picture as PNG into ComfyUI/output/P-H3 Image Idea and shows it on the node.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Show Text Pixaroma (the prompt P-H3 Image gets) - Shows the long prompt the upsampler wrote. Read it, copy it, or paste it into workflow 1 and edit it yourself.
  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: a smaller picture is much faster.

WhatTime
The upsampler writing the promptabout 6 s
1 megapixel pictureabout 3 s
2 megapixels, Full HD4 to 6 s
2K (2560 x 1440)about 9 s
4 megapixelsabout 10 s
8 megapixels, 4K (the demo is 8)about 20 s

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models (about 20 GB for H3, and 10 GB for the LoRA, the text encoder and the VAE), so it takes longer. After that they stay in memory, if your PC has enough of it. Two testers with 16 GB cards: with 64 GB of RAM the next Runs were close to the times above; with 32 GB the models loaded from disk again on every Run, and each Run took about 4 times as long.

 On a smaller card

Start with a 1 or 2 megapixel size, the first six on Sizes Pixaroma. They look good too.
